ideas.pitch: A multi-agent platform for industrial IoT network monitoring that combines graph intelligence with automated anomaly detection to prevent OT/ICS cyber attacks.
ideas.title: AutoGraph Industrial Threat Hunter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines genuine hard engineering in network topology analysis with the AI in Cybersecurity and AI in Industry Automation tracks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered CCTV log and traffic stream analyzer that detects unauthorized vehicle access in restricted smart city zones and coordinates emergency response.
ideas.title: UrbanFlow AI Traffic Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the AI in Smart Cities track directly by using real-time computer vision feeds and structured alert routing.

ideas.pitch: An automated threat investigation dashboard that ingests raw server logs, runs local anomaly detection, and provides explainable mitigation playbooks for security analysts.
ideas.title: SecureGuard SIEM Log Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses AI in Cybersecurity by automating high-volume log triage, mirroring award-winning log analysis architectures.

ideas.pitch: An edge-ready multi-agent diagnostic system that analyzes industrial sensor telemetry to predict machinery failures before they halt factory production lines.
ideas.title: FactoryFlow Predictive Maintenance Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the AI in Industry Automation track by delivering measurable cost-saving metrics that manufacturing judges prioritize.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized anomaly detection network for municipal smart grids that flags power surge patterns and isolates compromised sensor nodes automatically.
ideas.title: SmartGrid Resilience Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex distributed systems and robust fault tolerance tailored for the AI in Smart Cities track.
